name: iSlash omnichannel messaging
author: iSlash.io

sections.description:
iSlash is an innovative conversational management tool designed to streamline customer interactions and enhance business efficiency. By leveraging the WhatsApp API, iSlash enables businesses to automate their customer service, sales, and marketing processes. This all-in-one solution allows for easy setup of no-code chatbots, making it accessible for users without technical expertise.

Key features of iSlash AI include:

Multi-Channel Support:

  • Engage customers across various platforms such as WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, WeChat, and web interfaces.

Automation

  • Automate responses and interactions to improve customer engagement and satisfaction.

Promotional Broadcasting

  • Effortlessly send promotional offers and updates to customers, driving sales and enhancing marketing efforts.

User-Friendly Interface

  • Designed for ease of use, allowing businesses to implement chat solutions quickly and efficiently.

With iSlash, businesses can drive sales through automated chat marketing, ensuring they remain competitive in today’s digital landscape. This tool is ideal for companies looking to enhance their customer service capabilities while reducing operational costs.

Source Code Availability

This plugin uses Vue.js for the front-end. To comply with WordPress’s readability requirements, we provide access to the non-minified source code of Vue.js and our custom JavaScript files at the following links:

  • Non-minified Vue.js Source Code: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vue@3.5.13/dist/vue.js

Please refer to these resources for further development and understanding of how to work with our plugin.

External services

This plugin connects to an API to obtain the necessary data, including but not limited to token verify, history messages, message templates, payment records, documents etc.

This service is provided by ” iSlash Limited”.
EULA: https://islash.io/yue/eula
Privacy policy: https://islash.io/yue/privacy-policy, https://learn.islash.io/privacy/privacy-policy-end-users-2024-updates
Password policy: https://islash.io/password-policy

For more informations, please see via https://learn.islash.io/
